newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Italy's Dini says expects Malta to seek EU links.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini says expects Malta to seek EU links.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said on Monday he expected Malta would continue to seek close ties with the European Union despite the election of a party pledged to drop the island's EU membership bid.
Noting that countries across the Mediterranean had been seeking links with the 15-nation bloc, Dini said it was unlikely that Malta would turn its back.
"I would be surprised if Malta went in a different direction," he told Reuters at an EU foreign ministers meeting. "Fundamentally, it is in Malta's interest...to have closer links."
Italy has been Malta's main sponsor in its bid to join the EU.
Maltese Labour leader Alfred Sant claimed victory after an election on Sunday in which his party had promised to end Malta's bid to join Europe.
Former Nationalist Party prime minister Edward Fenech Adami accepted defeat.
